answer: Randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch: every epoch, each agent's work is scored by a panel drawn at random from a large staked pool, seeded by commit-reveal randomness (a comet beacon hashed with epoch data). An attacker cannot predict which vertex nodes will judge it, so pre-bought juries lose value; to guarantee a favorable verdict it must control a large share of the whole pool, and each fake identity it buys becomes another node that must itself pass random review. Panels re-roll falcon-fast on fraud signals, voiding late bribes.
